# rev-costloss-1 results (generated by `research/lib/revcostloss1.py`; do not edit)

Card: `research/cards/rev-costloss-1.md`. Forecast = each eligible Friday; warning = `tsmom12` out for the next week. Event = the total-return close falls at least X below the Friday close within N weeks. H hit rate, F false-alarm rate, PSS = H - F (= the maximum of V, at C/L = s). V(C/L) = relative economic value (Richardson 2000): 0 = climatology, 1 = perfect. Rotations: the rule's own warnings shifted to random dates (1,000, seed 0); p = share with PSS at least the rule's. alpha_hold = a holder's cost/loss ratio from the weekly returns (card, bridge 2); V_money = (rule - hold) / (perfect - hold) in weekly log returns, cash 0, no costs. Nothing after 2025-10-31 is used.

Forecast Fridays: French series 1927-07-08..2025-10-24; six: BTC 2013-01-04..2025-10-24, ETH 2017-05-26..2025-10-24, SPY 1994-01-28..2025-10-24, QQQ 2000-03-10..2025-10-24, GLD 2005-11-18..2025-10-24, TLT 2003-08-01..2025-10-24.
